conclusion: No preventive action can be verified as having a supported positive improvement. For all six selected actions, before/after harm values and computed improvements are null, and measurement support is unavailable due to missing site-specific inputs and lack of field calibration.
evidence_limits: No San Francisco site calibration or measured site inputs exist; calculations are mechanism-only and local damage probabilities and total losses are uncalibrated.

backup-pump@glass-0 is missing grid outage scenario, complete power/fuel/transfer chain, pump duty and inflow, and safe operating discharge; site basis is an owner survey address rather than evidence of damage, critical loads, or electrical connection.
